title: The passive 2
subtitle: Continuous forms, perfect forms, be going to and modals

blocks.text: **be** in the right form + past participle. For present simple, past simple and **will**, see Unit 10.

rows.example: My aunt is doing the washing-up. → The washing-up **is being done** by my aunt.
My cousin has sent the invitations. → The invitations **have been sent** by my cousin.
My uncle was cleaning the car. → The car **was being cleaned** by my uncle.
Our neighbours had taken the twins to the zoo. → The twins **had been taken** to the zoo by our neighbours.
They're going to invite Phil to the party. → Phil **is going to be invited** to the party.
They might invite Kyle to the party. → Kyle **might be invited** to the party.
We should tell Jenny about the party. → Jenny **should be told** about the party.
We must tell Dominic about the concert. → Dominic **must be told** about the concert.
We can hold the party at Jack's house. → The party **can be held** at Jack's house.

blocks.text: We can use **by** to emphasise who does something.
blocks.note: My sister's bedroom **was painted by** my parents. (= My parents painted my sister's bedroom.)

blocks.text: We can use **with** to emphasise what someone uses.
blocks.note: Soup is usually eaten **with** a spoon. (= You usually use a spoon to eat soup.)

blocks.text: We don't use **by** or **with** when we don't need to say, or don't know, who does something.
blocks.note: Mrs Fisher **was taken** to hospital yesterday.

exercises.title: A · Carnival lorry
exercises.instruction: Choose the ending that completes each sentence about the carnival lorry.

items.prompt: The carnival lorry is ___
options: been given a banana by the pirate
going to be given a balloon by the astronaut

items.prompt: The lorry has ___
options: been decorated with lots of flowers
been bought from a fancy-dress shop?
acceptedAnswers: been decorated with lots of flowers

items.prompt: The gorilla has ___
options: been given a banana by the pirate
acceptedAnswers: been given a banana by the pirate

items.prompt: Everyone watching is ___
options: going to be given a balloon by the astronaut
been decorated with lots of flowers
been given a banana by the pirate
acceptedAnswers: going to be given a balloon by the astronaut

items.prompt: The best song might ___
options: been bought from a fancy-dress shop?

items.prompt: Have the costumes ___
options: been bought from a fancy-dress shop?
been decorated with lots of flowers
acceptedAnswers: been bought from a fancy-dress shop?

exercises.title: B · Circle the correct word
exercises.instruction: Select the form that completes each sentence.

items.prompt: The balloons had all been ___ up before the carnival started.
The bananas ___ all been eaten yet.
The lorry isn't ___ driven by the gorilla.
A young boy ___ just taken a balloon from the astronaut.
A prize is going to ___ to the person in the best fancy dress.
The prize might not be ___ to the clown.
___ the lorry been decorated well?
Can songs be sung ___ people in the crowd, too?
That book was written ___ my uncle!
Are the best photos usually taken ___ digital cameras?
That song has been sung ___ lots of famous singers.
Is your hair cut ___ a professional hairdresser?
Should the paper be cut ___ a pair of scissors?
All the candles had been lit ___ the same match.
The film isn't going to be directed ___ Steven Spielberg after all.

exercises.title: D · Similar meaning
exercises.instruction: Complete each second sentence so that it has a similar meaning. Write no more than four words.

items.prompt: I think John has taken my jacket. — I think my jacket ___ John.
acceptedAnswers: I think my jacket has been taken by John.
I think my jacket has been taken by John

items.prompt: You should cook the chicken for at least an hour. — The chicken ___ for at least an hour.
acceptedAnswers: The chicken should be cooked for at least an hour.
The chicken should be cooked for at least an hour

items.prompt: They're showing that film at the cinema in town. — That film ___ at the cinema in town.
acceptedAnswers: That film is being shown at the cinema in town.
That film is being shown at the cinema in town

items.prompt: They hadn't invented digital cameras when we took that photo. — Digital cameras ___ when that photo was taken.
acceptedAnswers: Digital cameras hadn't been invented when that photo was taken.

items.prompt: When I got there, Carly was doing the ironing, so I didn't have to do it! — When I got there, the ironing ___ Carly, so I didn't have to do it!
acceptedAnswers: When I got there, the ironing was being done by Carly, so I didn't have to do it!

items.prompt: They were using hot soapy water to wash all the cars. — All the cars ___ hot soapy water.
acceptedAnswers: All the cars were being washed with hot soapy water.

exercises.title: E · Doing the housework
exercises.instruction: Complete the answers using the correct form of the passive.

items.prompt: Does only one person do the housework in Lisa's house? No, the housework ___ .
Who cooks the food? The food ___ by Lisa's dad.
Who is going to help Lisa's dad next weekend? Lisa's dad ___ .
acceptedAnswers: is going to be helped by everyone

items.prompt: Who did all the shopping until about a year ago? Until about a year ago, the shopping ___ by Lisa's mum.
Who has done most of the shopping since then? Since then, most of the shopping ___ by Lisa.
Does Lisa take the shopping home from the supermarket? No, it ___ to their house.
acceptedAnswers: is delivered by someone from the supermarket

items.prompt: How often does someone clean the bathroom? It ___ nearly every day.
When might someone next clean the bathroom? It ___ later today.
How does Angelina sweep the floors? The floors ___ with an old brush.
acceptedAnswers: are swept with an old brush

items.prompt: What does Lisa think Angelina should use? Lisa thinks a vacuum cleaner ___ .
